recommendation.text: 保持现有项目方向。先分别验证内容产能、IP 商务可行性与目标语言/地区漏斗；不把三款游戏排成跨平台收入榜。
recommendation.text_en: Preserve the current project direction. Test content capacity, IP feasibility and local funnels separately; do not create a cross-platform revenue ranking.
